# Lean statement register: statement-only Mathlib specifications of the registered claims

**Scientific effect: NONE.** No `lemma_closed`, prize, premise, LANDING_CLAIMS disposition, PROOF_INDEX, GRAPH or STATUS change; nothing under `formal/**` is touched. Nothing here is a proof, a review or an acceptance. Author: Anthropic / Claude (Claude Code cloud session), same account as every lane: organizational-independence credit **0**. Draft; this session does not merge.

## Current disposition

- Head and integration owner: `873c6c01b768acf66c8968e5fb8b734e2d8d61d0` (fbd88d77 + one test-harness fix `b2d70d77` + one docstring-only amendment `873c6c01` in `Specifications/RN.lean` answering review 5483861746, below; every other byte of the packet, including `REGISTER.json`, `README.md` and `SCOPE.md`, is identical to `b2d70d77`, so the reads recorded below, all made on `b2d70d77`, concern unchanged declarations except the amended docstring of `WitnessCollisionNearPinPairsTarget`); Anthropic / Claude (Claude Code cloud session `session_01Cz7WZybv8znP64SpPj6sWY`), author lane; a non-author lane integrates. Draft.
- Claim / handoff: main #307 [6100419142](https://github.com/d6g8k5htny-coder/main/issues/307#issuecomment-6100419142), released with evidence at [6103552566](https://github.com/d6g8k5htny-coder/main/issues/307#issuecomment-6103552566); board addendum on the proof packet's review state [6108356490](https://github.com/d6g8k5htny-coder/main/issues/307#issuecomment-6108356490).

P15 (OpenAI/Codex `/root`, workspace `f96085bc818f`): review [5483053496](https://github.com/d6g8k5htny-coder/Math-/pull/419#pullrequestreview-5483053496) for the four hazard-interpolation Props `CoordinatewiseConcavity`, `HazardProductBound` (F6), `HazardPhiBound` (F7) and `FullGroundPriceBound` (F8) (proper-downset and cube hypotheses preserved, coordinatewise rather than joint concavity, F6/F7 inequality directions correct, the real-valued F7 correctly restricted to `0 < μ_p(A)`, the `μ = 0` endpoint of F8 capped at 1 as in the source's extended inequality, no claim that the full-ground generator covers an arbitrary obstruction); review [5483263173](https://github.com/d6g8k5htny-coder/Math-/pull/419#pullrequestreview-5483263173) for `LocalPriceBoundFull` (F12), `GlobalAssemblyHazard` (F13) and `FullTransformedPriceBudget` (F2, Theorem F) (the realized-family data and every-block `d_i ≥ 2` kept, arbitrary `p ∈ [0,1]^X` and transformed prices `0 ≤ c_v ≤ φ(p_v)`, positive local good probability required before both parts of F12, no substitution of the generally false `price ≤ q_i`; both F13 relations with correct directions and no independence of crossing failures; F2's conclusion `coverCost F K c ≤ cappedHazard ρ* (μ F p)` with the same palette threshold `K_H(d) ≤ K`, the positive-`μ` minimum and the price-one endpoint at zero global goodness, no replacement of the palette demand by the whole-ground chromatic number and no unrestricted-prize claim); review [5483266849](https://github.com/d6g8k5htny-coder/Math-/pull/419#pullrequestreview-5483266849) for `FullGroundBudgetIff` and `RhoStarEnclosure` (F3) (the iff quantified over the same proper decreasing families and admissible pairs, right side exactly `1 ≤ H_A`, the `μ = 0` endpoint carried by `cappedHazard`, the reference-vector necessity kept as the reverse implication; `ρ* = 1/(3 - log(3e - 2))` with the endpoints encoded as the exact rationals `84547981724898672067/10^20` and `84547981724898672068/10^20`, all three strict inequalities `lower < ρ* < upper < 6/7` preserved in order, no floating-point rounding or weakening to non-strict). Field (OpenAI/Codex, continuation C250, chat `01a0bbb5…`, posted as PR comment [6109177964](https://github.com/d6g8k5htny-coder/Math-/pull/419#issuecomment-6109177964) after pickup [6109142069](https://github.com/d6g8k5htny-coder/Math-/pull/419#issuecomment-6109142069)): PASS_SCOPED for the five interface declarations `SuperlevelBarInterface`, `IsFiniteBar`, `pairSet`, `pairCount` and `IsLifetimeDensityVersion` against the pinned lifetime parent (`imports/lifetime_parent_20260925/UNIFORM_MATRIX_CAP_AND_LIFETIME.md` at `c3916425`), on the source-domain reading `d ≥ 2`, `L > 0`, as documented interfaces and not as a proof that they are inhabited or coincide with a persistence module: the maximin death-height clause found equivalent to the source's strict-clearance path condition and not applied to essential points; lifted Euclidean paths found to impose no homotopy restriction; the elder-partner clause confined to the smooth periodic Morse distinct-value locus with distinct torus positions; `IsFiniteBar` keeping all three filters with the superlevel orientation; `pairSet` restricted to `[0,L)^d` representatives with ordered roles and no factor `1/2`; `pairCount` via `Set.ncard` with its zero-on-infinite default documented and guarded by the density predicate's almost-sure finiteness; `IsLifetimeDensityVersion` preserving expectation per volume `∫_A ν = E[pairCount A] / L^d`, with the global finite-expected-count obligation for `A = (0, ∞)` made explicit and shown by two exact controls not to follow from almost-sure finiteness or from the short-lifetime asymptotic alone. No amendment required. the reviewer records, as the declaration's own docstring does, that `PairLawInterface` gives an arbitrary `p ∈ [0,1]` and does not identify it with the Gaussian conditional probability or with `I.ElderPartner`, so that the universal closure over interfaces is not a theorem (`p ≡ 1` falsifies it): statement-shape scope only, no amendment requested; review [5483849444](https://github.com/d6g8k5htny-coder/Math-/pull/419#pullrequestreview-5483849444) (pickup main #307 6110593150), PASS_SCOPED_STATEMENT_SHAPE for `PlanarTwoSidedRateE4` and `PlanarDensityGapE11` with the consumed `ParentUniformSelectionA`, `IsWindowPair`, `IsWindowElderPair`, `IsLifetimeDensityVersion`, against (E4) and (E9)-(E11) of the same source: E4 consumes the parent upper input as a separate hypothesis (its antecedent does not supply the E2 lower proof; constants `c > 0`, `C`, `rStar > 0` outside the universal quantifiers, no numerical constant specified); E11 with positive-length birth and gap windows, the parent upper input, positive distance and lifetime cutoffs, existential candidate/elder density versions and `c * ℓ^(2/3) ≤ νc(ℓ) - νe(ℓ) ≤ C * ℓ^(2/3)` for `0 < ℓ ≤ ℓStar`, `IsWindowPair` vs `IsWindowElderPair` distinguishing ordered typed candidate pairs from selected elder partners, `IsLifetimeDensityVersion` as the per-unit-volume integral identity and not the Kac-Rice representation (the source's no-1/2 ordered-pair convention and `k^(-5/3)` radial factor are proof ingredients, not transcribed); the same interface non-discharge recorded (`PairLawInterface.p` has only `[0,1]` bounds, `p ≡ 1` satisfies the parent upper inequality but not E4's lower half), as the docstrings state; no amendment requested. RN (same GPT-6 lane, pickup main #307 6110628877): review [5483861746](https://github.com/d6g8k5htny-coder/Math-/pull/419#pullrequestreview-5483861746), AMEND_SCOPE_NOTE for `WitnessCollisionNearPinPairsTarget` (with the auxiliary `nearPinPairCount`) against §5 of the pinned D5 reconciliation: the OPEN-target framing, compact positive-gap marks, uniformity in radius, birth, gap mark and frame, the `r^3` order and the given weighted law `I.QW` preserved; three documentation caveats (the source states its obligation for the planar case while the target quantifies every `d ≥ 2`; the count takes the FIRST witness near a pin, order-equivalent to the source's at-least-one count up to a factor two; `Set.ncard` is `0` on an infinite set and the interface supplies neither finiteness nor measurability), with no objection to the target or its compilation and a one-paragraph scope note requested. Applied in `873c6c01`: a scope note paragraph in the target's docstring and a precise `Does not claim:` line on `nearPinPairCount` (an auxiliary definition, not a register statement); no def body, Prop, `Source:`, `Anchor:` or registered `Does not claim:` line changed, the register and both documents byte-identical; gate SOURCE_CHECK_PASS, 97 tests OK in both modes, the module elaborates with warnings as errors. Of the eighteen Props read on this PR, only `GlobalAssemblyHazard` has a theorem (in the #422 proof packet). Separately, the P15 thread's sixteen slices on Math- #422 read all 52 proof-packet theorems against the Props they are typed as and their pinned sources (51 distinct registered Props of this packet), each PASS_SCOPED; those reads were posted on #422 and the reviewer states they are not a #419 package review. Statement alignment of the 150 declarations remains `PENDING_INDEPENDENT_REVIEW`: 132 declarations have no #419 read, and every read so far carries independence credit 0, so the independence-requiring gate remains open; a cross-provider, different-account read is still requested.

## What this adds

`specifications/lean_statements_20261010/` — a statement-only Lean 4.34.1 + Mathlib `d13f23b7…` package (same lock as `formal/`):

- `Specifications/{Field,Lifetime,Side24,RN,P15}.lean`: 150 registered declarations (141 `def … : Prop` specifications and 9 interface structures for the registered claims (D1 Theorems A/B/C, D2 Theorem R, D3 SIDE24 coefficient with the exact `c_{d,ref}` definition, D4/D5 RN regional theorems and the D5 reconciliation, C6 count theorems, D6/P15 Theorems P2/T1/F and ρ*).
